title: Deposit Operations Standards: Funding, Hold and Settlement Parameters for Savings Tiers
content:
Four settlement parameters of Savings & Money Market Accounts are set tier by tier: the smallest recurring automatic transfer amount that can be set up, whether interest accrued since the last cycle close is paid when the account closes mid-cycle, the business day after deposit on which a deposited check posts while the account is new, and the number of calendar days after the opening date during which that new-account treatment applies.

| Tier | Smallest recurring automatic transfer | Accrued interest paid on closure | Deposited check posts on business day | New-account period after opening |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter Savings | 25.00 USD | no, it is forfeited | 5th business day after deposit | 30 calendar days |
| Statement Savings | 25.00 USD | no, it is forfeited | 5th business day after deposit | 30 calendar days |
| Goal Builder Savings | 25.00 USD | no, it is forfeited | 5th business day after deposit | 30 calendar days |
| Money Market Account | 100.00 USD | yes | 5th business day after deposit | 30 calendar days |
| Premier Money Market | 100.00 USD | yes | 5th business day after deposit | 30 calendar days |
| Private Client Money Market | 100.00 USD | yes | 5th business day after deposit | 30 calendar days |

### Notes on the parameters

The recurring transfer minimum divides the range in two: 25.00 USD on the three savings tiers and 100.00 USD on the three money market tiers. The accrued interest parameter divides it the same way: on the three savings tiers interest accrued since the last cycle close is forfeited at a mid-cycle closure, and on the three money market tiers it is paid.

The two new-account parameters do not vary across Savings & Money Market Accounts: the hold figure is the 5th business day after deposit and the new-account period is 30 calendar days on every tier.
